All Regional P. F. Commissioner (In- Charge of Regions)

Sub: - Online Submission of monthly IW1 return. — regarding.

Sir,

As you may be aware that facility for online submission of IW-1 return by
employers has started from 1‘ November 2018.

It is observed that such returns are not being submitted online by concerned
employers of establishments employing “International Workers”.

You are hereby requested to conduct a special drive and awareness
Programme to induce establishments covered under your jurisdiction to submit
monthly IW1 return online through the International Workers portal on the EPFO

website www.epfindia.gov.in.

Action taken Report (ATR) in this regard should reach us within 15 days of
issues of this circular.

Yours faithfully,

Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner (HQ)
(International Workers Unit)
